title: mut.channel_memo_akten
mutation_directive: Channel Memo Akten — physics-driven, atmospheric, slow temporal evolution, sublime. Replace any 'snappy' interaction response with smooth integration over multiple seconds (LERP toward target with low alpha). Particles should have momentum and inertia. Add a slow-rotating environment — feel like the camera is on a rail moving through a scene that has DEPTH (foreground particles, background fog). Palette: cool blues, deep teals, oceanic. The piece should feel like staring at the ocean at dusk, not a tech demo.
